name: Land of Frankincense
description: In southern Oman's Dhofar region, this group of four sites traces the ancient frankincense trade. Wadi Dawkah has groves of the gnarled trees whose resin was once worth its weight in luxury. Nearby are the ruins of the caravan oasis at Shisr/Wubar and the old ports of Khor Rori and Al-Baleed, where the fragrant cargo set out across the world.
